verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents an official CLI that retrieves secrets and items for scripts and CI/CD pipelines. It also documents TOTP code generation for saved logins in its apps. However, nothing in the evidence shows the CLI or any API returning a current TOTP code. The CLI's listed item types don't mention TOTP, so combining two separate features would be speculative.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can fetch a current TOTP code programmatically — via CLI or API — to complete a 2FA login inside an automated workflow
